    name: "jsonschema-form",
    summary: "<h4>项目概述</h4>\n<p><code>@kne/jsonschema-form</code> 将 <strong>JSON Schema</strong> 转换为 <code>@kne/form-creator</code> Schema，并用 <code>SchemaRenderer</code> 渲染可提交表单。v1 以 form-creator 为唯一渲染层，不再在本包内手写字段与 GroupList。</p>\n<h4>主要特性</h4>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>结构映射</strong>：嵌套 <code>object</code> → <code>object</code> 模块；对象数组 → <code>list</code> + <code>itemBlocks</code>；标量数组 → <code>multiField</code></li>\n<li><strong>分支能力</strong>：<code>oneOf</code> → <code>choice</code>（单选），<code>anyOf</code> → <code>choice</code>（多选）</li>\n<li><strong>组合与引用</strong>：<code>allOf</code> 合并属性；同文档 <code>$ref</code>（<code>#/$defs</code>、<code>#/definitions</code>）内联</li>\n<li><strong>字段增强</strong>：<code>format</code> 自动映射类型/规则；<code>x-widget</code> / <code>ui:widget</code> 自定义组件；<code>x-props</code> 透传 props</li>\n<li><strong>双入口</strong>：组件 <code>JSONSchemaForm</code> 直接渲染，或 <code>jsonSchemaToFormCreatorSchema</code> 只做转换</li>\n</ul>\n<h4>使用场景</h4>\n<ul>\n<li>后端下发 JSON Schema，前端需要快速生成 Ant Design 表单</li>\n<li>已有 form-creator 生态，希望用标准 JSON Schema 驱动同一套渲染</li>\n<li>调试 / 中间层需要查看「JSON Schema → form-creator Schema」转换结果</li>\n</ul>",
    description: "将 JSON Schema 转换为 @kne/form-creator Schema 并渲染表单",
    
    packageName: "@kne/jsonschema-form",
    api: "<h4>JSONSchemaForm</h4>\n<p>将 JSON Schema 转为 form-creator Schema，并委托 <code>SchemaRenderer</code> 渲染。</p>\n<h5>属性</h5>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>属性名</th>\n<th>类型</th>\n<th>默认值</th>\n<th>描述</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td>schema</td>\n<td><code>object</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>JSON Schema 根对象</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>column</td>\n<td><code>number</code></td>\n<td><code>2</code></td>\n<td>转换时写入各模块的默认列数</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>gap</td>\n<td><code>number</code></td>\n<td><code>24</code></td>\n<td>字段间距</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>onSubmit</td>\n<td><code>(data, ...args) =&gt; any</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>提交回调（写入 <code>formProps.onSubmit</code>）</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>formProps</td>\n<td><code>object</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>透传给 SchemaRenderer / 底层 Form</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>rules</td>\n<td><code>object</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>额外校验规则，合并进 <code>formProps.rules</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>footer</td>\n<td><code>ReactNode | false</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td><code>false</code> 隐藏操作区；传入节点时作为自定义 actions</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>actions</td>\n<td><code>ReactNode | object | false</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>同 form-creator <code>SchemaRenderer</code> 的 actions；<code>false</code> 隐藏操作区</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>...rest</td>\n<td><code>object</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>其余属性合并进 <code>formProps</code></td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h4>jsonSchemaToFormCreatorSchema</h4>\n<p>纯函数：JSON Schema → <code>@kne/form-creator</code> Schema（含 <code>blocks</code>）。</p>\n<h5>参数</h5>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>参数名</th>\n<th>类型</th>\n<th>默认值</th>\n<th>描述</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td>jsonSchema</td>\n<td><code>object</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>JSON Schema</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>options.column</td>\n<td><code>number</code></td>\n<td><code>2</code></td>\n<td>默认列数</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>options.gap</td>\n<td><code>number</code></td>\n<td><code>24</code></td>\n<td>默认间距</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h5>返回值</h5>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>类型</th>\n<th>描述</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>object</code></td>\n<td>form-creator Schema：<code>{ title, subtitle, column, gap, blocks, actions? }</code></td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h4>转换对照</h4>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>JSON Schema</th>\n<th>form-creator</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td>object 标量字段</td>\n<td><code>formInfo</code> / <code>object</code> 的 <code>list</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>嵌套 object</td>\n<td><code>object</code>（可再挂 <code>blocks</code>）</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>array of object</td>\n<td><code>list</code> + <code>itemBlocks</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>array of 标量</td>\n<td><code>multiField</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>oneOf</td>\n<td><code>choice</code>（<code>mode: 'single'</code>）</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>anyOf</td>\n<td><code>choice</code>（<code>mode: 'multiple'</code>）</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>allOf</td>\n<td>合并 <code>properties</code> / <code>required</code> 后再转</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>同文档 fieldFromSchema</h4>\n<p>底层转换工具，一般无需直接使用；需要定制转换流水线时可单独导入。</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>导出</th>\n<th>描述</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>resolveRef(schema, root)</code></td>\n<td>解析同文档 <code>$ref</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>mergeAllOf(schema, root)</code></td>\n<td>合并 <code>allOf</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>fieldFromSchema(name, schema, options?)</code></td>\n<td>单个属性 → form-creator field</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>FORMAT_FIELD_MAP</code></td>\n<td>format → 字段类型/规则映射表</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p>&lt;!--START_SECTION:DOC_MD--&gt;</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>组件</th>\n<th>简介</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><a     code: "const { default: JSONSchemaForm } = _JsonschemaForm;\nconst { default: JsonView } = _JsonView;\nconst { message, Flex, Typography } = antd;\n\nconst resumeSchema = {\n  title: '个人简历',\n     code: "const { jsonSchemaToFormCreatorSchema } = _JsonschemaForm;\nconst { default: JsonView } = _JsonView;\nconst { Flex, Typography, Button, message } = antd;\nconst { useMemo, useState } = React;\n\nconst sourceSchema = {\n  title: '演示转换',\n  type: 'object',\n  required: ['name'],\n  properties: {\n    name: { type: 'string', title: '姓名' },\n    tags: { type: 'array', title: '标签', items: { type: 'string' } },\n    profile: {\n      type: 'object',\n      title: '档案',\n      properties: {\n        city: { type: 'string', title: '城市' }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n};\n\nconst panelStyle = { flex: '1 1 360px', minWidth: 320 };\n\nconst BaseExample = () => {\n  const creatorSchema = useMemo(() => jsonSchemaToFormCreatorSchema(sourceSchema, { column: 2, gap: 24 }), []);\n  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);\n\n  return (\n    <Flex vertical gap={16}>\n      <Typography.Paragraph type=\"secondary\" style={{ margin: 0 }}>\n        仅调用 <Typography.Text code>jsonSchemaToFormCreatorSchema</Typography.Text>\n        ，得到可交给 form-creator <Typography.Text code>SchemaRenderer</Typography.Text> 的 Schema。\n      </Typography.Paragraph>\n      <Flex gap={8}>\n        <Button\n          type=\"primary\"\n          onClick={async () => {\n            const text = JSON.stringify(creatorSchema, null, 2);\n            try {\n              await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);\n              setCopied(true);\n              message.success('已复制转换结果');\n            } catch (e) {\n              console.log(text);\n              message.info('已输出到控制台');\n            }\n          }}\n        >\n          复制转换结果\n        </Button>\n        {copied ? <Typography.Text type=\"success\">已复制</Typography.Text> : null}\n      </Flex>\n      <Flex gap={16} align=\"flex-start\" wrap=\"wrap\">\n        <Flex vertical gap={8} style={panelStyle}>\n          <Typography.Text strong>JSON Schema（输入）</Typography.Text>\n          <JsonView data={sourceSchema} theme=\"light\" collapsedFrom={2} searchable={false} />\n        </Flex>\n        <Flex vertical gap={8} style={panelStyle}>\n          <Typography.Text strong>form-creator Schema（输出）</Typography.Text>\n          <JsonView data={creatorSchema} theme=\"light\" collapsedFrom={2} searchable={false} />\n        </Flex>\n      </Flex>\n    </Flex>\n  );\n};\n\nrender(<BaseExample />);\n\n",
